title: Simplify posting flow to immediate publish (remove moderation/admin workflow)

requirements.text: Remove the submission moderation workflow from the Motoko backend by eliminating the Pending/Approved/Rejected states and any ArticleSubmission-based approval logic, so user uploads are stored as published Articles immediately.

quotes:
Simplify Posting Flow – Immediate Publish
Remove the approval workflow entirely.
Required behavior:
When any user uploads a post (text + image URL), it should be saved as Published immediately
Remove all Pending / Approval / Rejected states from backend and UI
Home and News feeds must show all published posts without role checks
Remove or ignore any admin-only UI or logic related to moderation

acceptanceCriteria: Backend no longer defines or uses a SubmissionStatus enum/variant for article publishing.
Backend no longer stores or returns ArticleSubmission records for moderation purposes (no pending queue).
Backend no longer exposes moderation-related canister methods (approveSubmission, rejectSubmission, approveOrRejectSubmission, getPendingArticles).
A signed-in user upload results in an Article being added to the articles collection immediately and returned by getAllArticles and relevant filter queries.

requirements.text: Update the backend upload API so that the existing user upload flow saves content directly into the Articles store (immediate publish) while still requiring the caller to be an authenticated user (Internet Identity).

quotes: Any post uploaded by any user should be saved and immediately shown in Home and News feeds.

acceptanceCriteria: The canister provides an update method that the frontend upload page can call to publish an upload immediately (either repurpose submitArticle to write to articles, or introduce a new method and update the frontend accordingly).
The method rejects anonymous callers (keeps the existing requirement that the user must be signed in).
The published Article includes at minimum: id, promotion, category, publishDate, imageUrl, summary, content (matching the existing Article model fields in backend/main.mo).

requirements.text: Remove all admin-only authorization requirements related to creating/publishing articles so Home and News feeds show all published articles without role checks.

quotes:
Home and News feeds must show all published posts without role checks
Remove all admin, approval, and moderation logic.

acceptanceCriteria: No published-article query method (getAllArticles, getArticlesByPromotion, getArticlesByCategory, getArticlesByPromotionAndCategory, searchArticles, getArticleById) requires admin permissions.
No admin-only gates remain that would prevent user-published content from being returned in feeds.

requirements.text: Update frontend React Query hooks to remove moderation/admin APIs and align the upload mutation with immediate publish, including invalidating/refetching article list queries so new uploads appear in Home and News immediately.

quotes:
When any user uploads a post (text + image URL), it should be saved as Published immediately
On approval, posts must immediately appear in Home and News feeds
Remove or ignore any admin-only UI or logic related to moderation

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts no longer imports or references SubmissionStatus or moderation-only types/hooks (pending list, approve/reject).

The upload/submission mutation called by the upload page triggers invalidation of all relevant article queries (at minimum queryKey ['articles']) so navigating back to Home/News shows the new item without hard refresh.
Any admin-check hook (useIsCallerAdmin) is removed or becomes unused and is not required for feeds or uploading.

requirements.text: Update the Upload page UI and behavior so authenticated users publish immediately, and remove all references to approval/pending states from user-facing text and payload fields.

quotes: Remove all Pending / Approval / Rejected states from backend and UI

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/UploadSubmissionPage.tsx no longer sets `status: SubmissionStatus.pending` on the payload.
UploadSubmissionPage user-facing text no longer mentions admin approval or pending review (e.g., replace “Submit for Approval” / “pending admin approval” with immediate publish language).
After a successful upload, the confirmation state tells the user the post is published and can be seen in feeds immediately.

requirements.text: Remove or disable all admin-only moderation UI, routes, and navigation entry points so the app no longer exposes Admin Approval or Admin Upload screens.

quotes:
Remove all admin, approval, and moderation logic.
Do not show or reference any admin-only UI.

acceptanceCriteria: Profile page no longer shows an “Admin Access” section or links/buttons to '/admin/upload-article' or '/admin/approval'.

Routes for '/admin/upload-article' and '/admin/approval' are removed from frontend/src/App.tsx route tree, or replaced with a non-admin accessible state that does not reference admin/moderation functionality.
AdminApprovalPage and AdminUploadArticlePage are no longer reachable through in-app navigation.

requirements.text: Keep the existing global search bar and upload button in the app header unchanged while ensuring search continues to work against the published Articles dataset.

quotes: Keep the existing upload button and search bar unchanged

acceptanceCriteria: No functional or visual regressions in the existing AppHeader search input and Upload navigation affordance.
Search results continue to be returned from the backend searchArticles API and displayed by existing page logic where search is used.
Uploading remains accessible via the existing Upload button navigation flow.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not modify immutable hook entrypoints under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep the existing global search bar and upload button UI in the header unchanged.
nonGoals: Do not add new admin features, moderation queues, or role-based publishing controls.
Do not add external databases, third-party auth providers, or real-time messaging.
Do not redesign the overall navigation/tab structure or replace the search experience beyond what is required to remove moderation dependencies.
